title: Competition routine

D0.outcome: Explains an event routine: preparation, between-round routine, post-event debrief.

D1.outcome: Writes a routine for a two-game event (sleep, food, review, opponent notes).

D2.outcome: Follows a written event routine across a whole event and records what varied.

D3.outcome: Debriefs an event with pattern analysis and states what to change.

conditions: The learner has competed enough to have a baseline.
contrasts: A routine that is new on the day of the event.
